answer: Locks are recorded in oasis, expire in ferrous, and whisper lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 125 aliases thus needs 88 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 844 identities would post 1944 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
